title: Set 38

sentences.ko: 우리 개가 사람은 잘 따르는데, 누가 문을 두드리면 완전히 뒤집어져요. 그래서 요즘은 그냥 제가 밖에 나가서 택배 기사님을 만나요. 다들 번거롭지 않게요.
sentences.text: My dog's great with people until somebody knocks, and then he completely loses it, so now I just meet the delivery guy out front to save everybody the trouble.

alts.text: Around people my dog's a sweetheart, but the second somebody knocks he goes nuts, so now I just meet the delivery guy out front and save everybody the hassle.
My dog is wonderful with people until someone knocks at the door, at which point he becomes completely unmanageable, so I now meet the delivery driver outside in order to spare everyone the trouble.

sentences.note: **loses it** 는 흥분해서 이성을 잃는다는 뜻이고, **save everybody the trouble** 은 다른 사람들 수고를 덜어 준다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 마음에 들긴 해. 그런데 너 이거랑 거의 똑같은 재킷 이미 있지 않아? 아직 환불 되는 거면 나 같으면 그 돈을 네가 계속 말하던 그 부츠에 보탤 것 같아.
sentences.text: I do like it, but you've basically got that same jacket already, right? If you can still take it back, I'd put it toward those boots you keep talking about.

alts.text: It's nice! But isn't that pretty much the same jacket you've got at home? If you can still return it, I'd put that money toward the boots you keep bringing up.
I do like it, but you already own a nearly identical jacket, don't you? If it can still be returned, I would put the money toward the boots you have been mentioning.

sentences.note: **take it back** 은 산 물건을 가게에 도로 가져가 무르는 것이고, **put it toward** 는 그 돈을 다른 물건 사는 데 보탠다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 신발까지 신고 나갈 준비를 다 했었어. 그런데 여동생이 전화해서 회사 일로 속상해하길래 계단에 앉아서 한 시간을 통화했지. 그러고 나니 나갈 이유가 없더라.
sentences.text: I had my shoes on and everything, but then my sister called and she was upset about work, so I sat on the stairs talking to her for an hour, and by then there was no point.

alts.text: Shoes were on, I was ready to walk out, and then my sister called all upset about work, so I'm sitting on the stairs with her for an hour, and after that, what was the point?
I had already put on my shoes, but then my sister called, upset about work, and I sat on the stairs speaking with her for an hour, by which point there was no longer any reason to go.

sentences.note: **had my shoes on and everything** 는 나갈 준비를 완전히 다 마쳤다는 것을 강조하는 말이고, **there was no point** 는 이제 해 봐야 의미가 없다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 형네 집 근처에 지금 내는 돈으로 진짜 마당까지 있는 집이 나왔어. 그런데 다들 사는 데서 사십 분 거리야. 내가 내 성격을 알잖아. 주말마다 차 몰고 나오겠다고 큰소리쳐 놓고 결국 안 나올 거야.
sentences.text: There's a place near my brother's with an actual yard for what I'm paying now, but it's forty minutes from everyone, and I know me, I'd swear I'd drive in every weekend and then I just wouldn't.

alts.text: Near my brother's there's a place with a real yard for the same money I'm paying now, but it's forty minutes from everybody, and I know myself, I'd swear I'd drive in every weekend and then I just wouldn't.

There is a place near my brother's with an actual yard for what I am paying now, but it is forty minutes from everyone, and I know myself, I would promise to drive in every weekend and then I simply would not.

sentences.note: **I know me** 는 내가 내 성격을 안다는 구어 표현이고, **I'd swear I'd** 는 꼭 그러겠다고 장담해 놓고서 라는 뜻으로 이어집니다.

sentences.ko: 다들 내가 지금 얼마 버는지 궁금해했어. 나는 계속 괜찮다고, 괜찮다고만 했는데 삼촌이 그 얘기를 끝까지 안 놔주는 거야. 그래서 결국 부엌에서 아무도 시키지 않은 설거지 물기나 닦고 있었어.
sentences.text: They all wanted to know what I'm making now, and I kept saying it's fine, it's fine, but my uncle would not let it go, so I ended up in the kitchen drying dishes nobody asked me to dry.

alts.text: Everybody wanted to know what I'm making now, and I just kept going it's fine, it's fine, but my uncle wouldn't drop it, so I ended up in the kitchen drying dishes nobody asked me to dry.

They all wanted to know what I am earning now, and I kept saying that it was fine, that it was fine, but my uncle would not let the subject go, so I ended up in the kitchen drying dishes that no one had asked me to dry.

sentences.note: **let it go** 는 그 얘기를 그만두고 넘어간다는 뜻이라 would not let it go 는 끝까지 물고 늘어졌다는 말이 됩니다. **ended up** 은 결국 그렇게 되고 말았다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

reviewed: 넷째 문장 한국어에서 방향이 어긋나 있었습니다. "차 몰고 오겠다"고 해 놓고 뒤에서는 "안 갈 거야"라 오고 가는 방향이 뒤섞였습니다. "나오겠다 / 안 나올 거야"로 통일했습니다.
둘째 문장 formal 의 "do you not?" 는 소리내어 읽으면 지나치게 굳은 말투라 "don't you?" 로 바꿨습니다. 격식은 유지되면서 사람이 실제로 하는 말이 됩니다.
다섯째 문장 formal 에서 옮긴 말의 시제가 어긋나 있었습니다(kept saying that it is fine). 격식체에서는 시제를 맞춰 "that it was fine" 이라 합니다. 뜻은 그대로입니다.
둘째 문장 한국어 "아직 환불 되면" 을 "아직 환불 되는 거면" 으로 다듬었습니다. 친구에게 말할 때 쓰는 말투에 더 가깝습니다.
